notes: Dyk Storybook v2 is the reference implementation for shared-renderer UI governance.
Production persistent Docker state uses host bind mounts.

Production deploys: deploy/AGENTS.md grants standing authorization for assigned changes to Dyk's own target with release evidence, verification, isolation and rollback gates binding. Owner decision netbka/engineering-platform#82 accepted this form and retired the per-deploy owner trigger.
Open request (#82): remove the git push origin main and one-off ssh rm -rf allowances from .claude/settings.json; they contradict Dyk principle P1.
Observed, not verified: the change manifest rejects controller-only evidence (GOV-16). The independent verifier gate stays not-enabled until verified, because enabling it is a one-way ratchet.
Browser-driven tests are banned; screenshots and browser review are review evidence, not tests (AGENTS.md section 8). A project method choice, not a tightening of a generic rule.

ownerReserved.summary: Changing the Product Constitution or PRINCIPLES.
Owner approves a new visible result in Storybook before production implementation.
ownerReserved.retiresWhen: Dyk design gate (principle check, customer-eye review, screenshots) is live and an owner-merged change records it in docs/STATE.md.

stricter.summary: Unsupported or invented facts are a hard product gate, not a tradeable metric.
Owner or grant is re-checked on the server for every request, job, history load and AI context (S1).
A ROADMAP item is not an assignment; an agent never picks the next item itself.
U2 numeric interaction budgets by goal frequency, measured from where the need is visible.
44px minimum pointer targets, above the WCAG 2.2 floor.

releaseAuthorization.summary: Standing deploy authorization for assigned changes to Dyk's own target; release evidence, independent verification, isolation and rollback stay binding.
